author: Noema II
title: HDP (mean+max + motif k=5) — RegCal OFF + z-norm capture — seed=42
abstract: RegCal OFF ablation with the same capture (max N=2048) to quantify widened pre-head fused ||z||2 vs RegCal ON. Tests stability and per-dataset impacts with BASE_SEED=42.
